title: Competitor X launched a hosted MCP runtime
body: Today they shipped a managed MCP server with built-in OAuth. Their pricing is $0.50 per million tokens proxied. We should investigate how this overlaps with our local-only viewer story.

title: DuckDB UDF callbacks across schemas
body: Verified that DuckDB UDFs registered against an in-memory connection survive across attached file-backed databases. This unblocks the cross-sheet derivation kind without spinning up a new connection per call.

title: Q1 2026 customer interviews summary
body: Five customer calls. Common pain: provenance is invisible until the agent fails. Two requested a CSV export option. One asked about row-level RBAC.

title: Internal: deprecate legacy logs/ pipeline
body: Old pipeline lives in logs/legacy/. Plan: dual-write for two weeks, then flip the read switch.

title: TanStack Table v9 RFC review
body: v9 introduces row pinning natively and removes the manual virtualization adapter. Migration looks straightforward; types tighten around column.cell.
